programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Pedro perdió sensibilidad en su pene cuando le hicieron la circuncisión, quiere que su hermano gemelo le done su miembro. Patricia salió embarazada de Marco, pero no ha elegido al mejor padre.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Laura provocó la muerte por asfixia de su bebé, de forma accidental, tras consumir marihuana. Además, Gilbert es trabajador del negocio de Raúl, pero siente que este siempre lo ha discriminado.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: A Carlos le queda un año de vida y lo quiere pasar tranquilo, pero vive con un gótico sadomasoquista. Andrea quiere la custodia de su hermano para protegerlo de su padre maltratador.
programme.sub-title: Viviendo con Satán/Justicia para mi madre

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: José desaparece y Carolina tiene que vender un riñón por algo de dinero. Por otro lado, Teresa descubre que Israel le es infiel y por venganza hace público su engaño con un cartel.
programme.sub-title: Por un riñón / Cómo vengarse de un infiel

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Fabio tiene una finca en la frontera con México y mata a los indocumentados que cruzan por ahí. Además, Vicente es un músico que se quedó rezagado con la tecnología, su hija se aprovecha.
programme.sub-title: Si cruzas la frontera te mato / Piratería en la industria musical

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Raúl recibió en un trasplante el corazón del hijo de Elizabeth, ahora ella cree ser familia. Por otro lado, Omaira quiere adoptar a un niño de supuestamente 8 años, pero hay algo oculto.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Oriel exige la custodia del hijo que tiene con Sindy porque no lo deja comer carne. Además, Willian y Marie están casados, hacen un trío con una escultora y producen dildos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Mariana contrató una empresa de referidos para residencias de ancianos y ahora es un problema. Ketty dice que su hijo fue secuestrado por alienígenas que le dieron poder para salvar al mundo.
programme.sub-title: Mina de oro de anciano / Niño extraterrestre

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Samuel desapareció por un año y lo declararon muerto, pero regresa y descubre una nueva faceta de su esposa. Carlos era pareja de Sonia, pero se fue de casa con una de las hijas de ella.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alejandro se fue de fiesta, bebió mucho y despertó en el hospital golpeado y desgarrado analmente. Juan ganó la lotería, como es indocumentado acordó con su jefe cobrar el premio y dividirlo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El esposo de Wendy desapareció, el hombre perdió la memoria y se volvió a casar. Además, María fue llevada a La Fábrica, una finca donde prostituyen y trafican mujeres.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ivete quiere ir a Puerto Rico en busca de su hijo desaparecido tras el paso del huracán María, su esposo se niega. Cornelio ha soportado las infidelidades de su esposa y no quiere el divorcio.
programme.sub-title: María perdió a mi hijo / Felizmente cornudo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El hermano de Carlos está en coma por un intento de suicidio que, según él, fue inducido por una chica. Dennis y José tienen una asociación de ayuda al inmigrante, pero José cambió su enfoque.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El novio de Lucía está enfermo, pero la esposa legal le quita el derecho a cuidarlo. Además, el esposo de Ivonne padece una condición que lo hace orinarse y defecar cuando tiene un orgasmo.
programme.sub-title: Te toqué el Cuatro / Enfermedad de hombres

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Hace años Pedro salvó la vida de las gemelas Gabriela y Daniela, ahora las chicas se volvieron ingratas. También, Claribel tiene orden de deportación y no quiere llevarse a su hija.

UWC continues to grow and to bring the fight fans across Europe the fights they want to see.

programme.desc: Julio le da su apoyo a Leandro con su nueva canción y le ofrece un patrocinio para que la grabe. Por otro lado, Matilde y Moisés se reconcilian. Más tarde, Tomasa sospecha de Arturo y, debido a esto, decide seguir a Gerardo.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: Moisés y Leandro sufren por la viruela. Matilde se dedica a cuidar de su marido. Nacha decide cuidar de su hijo Leandro, quien al mejorar le agradece componiéndole La viruela. Arturo intenta persuadir a Gerardo de desistir del robo de ganado.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: Ante la llegada de Olimpo, Arturo decide dejarle el camino libre a Gala. Moisés le miente a Matilde sobre Plácida. Erótida y Mauricio hablan de lo que pudo haber sido su vida. A pesar de su disfonía, Leandro sigue con sus planes de grabar el disco.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Después de hablar con Miguel Corona, Steve le envía un mensaje a Emiliano donde lo acusan de ser el asesino de Martin del Valle. Por otro lado, el capitán Bernal retoma la investigación en Colombia con los datos que le envía el comandante Salas.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Los mariachis le dedican una canción a la nueva novia de Mañanitas. Lourdes le aclara a Mañanitas que ella es prostituta. Por otro lado, Leticia hace un nuevo amigo en el bar. Fernando se enoja al ver a Leticia con su nuevo amigo.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Debido a su falta de experiencia, Mañanitas interrumpe varias veces a Emiliano mientras este trata de estar con Rosario. Por otro lado, el capitán Bernal y sus hombres continúan buscando pistas.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El capitán Bernal llama al comandante Salas para informarle que Martin Del Valle estuvo en Colombia con Emiliano y que hallaron un cómplice llamado Fernando. Por otro lado, Virginia encuentra en la oficina de Carlos el sobre con la plata para Raquel.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano presiona a Fernando para que le diga a Letty lo que siente o de lo contrario podría perderla. Por otro lado, Carlos descubre que han sacado el sobre con la plata para Raquel.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El Coloso recibe una noticia por parte de Carmen Román donde asegura tener un hijo de él. El Coloso decide rechazar la paternidad del hijo que Carmen menciona. Por otro lado, la policía busca a Fernando Molina para interrogarlo.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Diomedes hace las paces con Bertha y entre los dos escogen el nombre de la niña. Arjona se da cuenta que Diomedes estaba en la ventana de Lucia y le dispara. Por otra parte, Lucia es llevada al convento de Bucaramanga y Diomedes llega a visitarla.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Diomedes se sube a un árbol para cantarle a Lucia. Por otra parte, Diomedes llega a Valledupar a estudiar, donde le roban todo su dinero y llega a casa de José Olarte a pedir ayuda.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Diomedes entra al convento para ver a Lucia, ella le da una carta expresándole su amor; Diomedes se hace pasar por una monja para ver a Lucia. Pasan tres años, Lucia adolescente sale del convento y regresa a la Junta.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Diomedes le manda una carta a Lucia con Vilma, donde le pone una cita y están juntos. A casa de Elvira llega una india con una hija de Diomedes, Bertha se entera y le cuenta a Lucia. Por otra parte, Lucia decide no escaparse con Diomedes.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Beatriz lee la carta que Lucia escribió, ella se alegra al ver que su hija vuelve a casa; Felipe llega a visitar a Lucia y comienzan a salir, Diomedes se pone celoso. Por otra parte, Diomedes regresa al colegio y compone una canción de despecho.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Diomedes participa en un concurso de música en el colegio, donde es el ganador. Felipe le propone a Lucia ser novios, ella termina aceptando. Diomedes inicia grabando dos canciones, Diomedes le manda una carta a Lucia, pero Beatriz no se la entrega.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Carmen llega con Roro al bar Garibaldi, ella no quiere irse hasta que Manuel oiga cantar al Chiquillo. El coloso, furioso, le pide a Carmen que se vaya. Roro se subirá a la tarima a cantar, el Coloso quedara atónito al escuchar a su hijo.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rodrigo Román alias el Monumental continua ganándose el corazón del Coloso cantando en tarima. Por otro lado, el capitán Bernal y sus hombres llegan al bar Garibaldi con la fotografía del fugitivo Emiliano Sanchez Gallardo.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rosario queda destrozada al ver la fotografía del fugitivo Emiliano Sanchez. Fernando al ver la foto corre a cogerla para ocultarla. Emiliano tratara de explicarle a Rosario lo que pasa pero ella, furiosa, le pedirá que se aleje para siempre de ella.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rosario continúa destrozada por la noticia que recibió por parte de la policía y decide quedarse encerrada. Por otro lado, Emiliano alista el traje de mariachi para devolverlo. El mexicano renuncia en el bar diciendo que se va para su país.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano busca hospedaje en la calle de la laguna. Mientras tanto, Javier Macías busca un apartamento de lujo para alquilarlo. Por otro lado, Carlos Malagón le comunica a los mariachis que Emiliano renuncio, Fernando decide salir a buscarlo.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Fernando y Sigifredo deciden buscar a Emiliano en la calle de la Laguna, se llevaran una gran sorpresa al ver a Emiliano borracho cantando en un bar. Emiliano terminara confesándole a Sigifredo toda la verdad sobre su verdadera identidad.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: Gracias a Reinaldo, Leandro recupera su voz. Arturo queda en evidencia frente a los Pantoja. Don Julio, con rabia por el asunto del robo de ganado, amenaza a Arturo y a su familia. Onofre, Nacha, Tomasa y Urbano vuelven a Los Pajales.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: Arturo va a Barranquilla y conoce a Miriam, quien roba sus pertenencias. Al llegar a Barranquilla, Arturo consigue que un empresario musical lo contrate. Leandro logra recuperar la confianza de los tocaimeros y termina la canción dedicada a ellos.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The discovery of a Saint's bones at an archaeological dig causes a stir in the village of Midsomer Cicely. But when the leader of the dig is murdered, DCI Barnaby and DS Nelson soon realise that it's not only skeletons that have been long buried in the hallowed ground.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The annual fair and the daredevil riders of the Wall of Death come to Midsomer village Whitcombe Mallet. When the owner of an equestrian centre is trampled by his horse DCI Barnaby and DS Nelson have to unravel a complex feud from the past, where nothing is what it seems...

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Peter and Caroline Cave are house-hunting in Midsomer Newton. Shortly before leaving their hotel they mention they haven't been able to find what they're looking for; "something old and derelict that they can do up." Anne Merrick tells them about Winyard, a tumbledown cottage in the woods, might be for sale. At the estate agents they are told the house is not yet available for viewing. Later that evening they find the house on their own. However, Caroline has read up on the cottage's haunted reputation and only reluctantly explores it with Peter. The next morning they are found strangled in their own car. DCI Barnaby starts the investigation with the help of PC Ben Jones and they come across the world of estate agents, identical twins, ghosts, piano wire, and more before another body turns up.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Villagers of Midsomer Barton are all set to celebrate Oak Apple Week, especially as the carnival queen event is set to return after an eight year absence. Yet the body of the mother of a deceased, one-time carnival queen, found in a stream, looks set to spoil things, as Barnaby and Jones find themselves digging up the past. From familiar faces, to drunken boasts and hidden obessions, it slowly becomes clear that the mother's daughter might be the key to solving the murder, when more deaths follow.

programme.title: Winchester Life

After a multi-day journey by airand sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Winchester Life

programme.title: Winchester Life

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, we uncover true accounts from around the world that feel almost impossible. A fisherman off the coast of Chile is taken by a breaching whale. A diver vanishes into darkness and finds himself trapped inside the mouth of a humpback whale. Two kayakers are lifted from the water by something massive lurking just below the surface of the ocean.These are not legends. These are real people telling their stories.We also revisit one of the most powerful moments in the Bible. The story of Jonah. Scripture tells us that God prepared a great fish to swallow Jonah for a divine purpose. Could something like that still happen today? What does science say about surviving inside a whale? And are these modern encounters more than just coincidence?

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: The movie Jaws was inspired by a string of shark attacks... some in FRESHWATER! In this eerie episode of Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green explores the shocking reality of sharks found in freshwater. From bull sharks traveling up the Mississippi River to strange reports out of the Great Lakes, we examine how far these predators can really go. You'll hear about bull sharks in Lake Nicaragua, the science behind their survival in rivers and lakes, and theories about whether they could adapt to colder waters. It's a mix of strange history, biology, and firsthand accounts that might make you think twice before jumping in.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: Deep in the backroads of the Midwest there are stories locals rarely tell out loud. Stories of pale figures with oversized heads watching from the trees. Stories passed down in whispers and warnings. The Melon Heads legend has haunted Michigan, Ohio, and surrounding states for decades. Some say they are the result of dark experiments. Others believe they are something far older. Something that never left the woods.

programme.title: My Troublesome Star Ep.2
programme.desc: Actress Im Se Ra (Jang Da A) is on top of the world after becoming the youngest winner of a best actress award. Unfortunately, that same night, she's hit by a truck - and transported 25 years into the future, where she wakes up in the body of middle-aged woman Bong Cheong Ja (Uhm Jung Hwa). Cheong Ja decides to return to acting, hoping to restore her former glory and figure out what happened to her. She's assisted by Dokgo Cheol (Song Seung Heon), a former violent crimes detective who got demoted to traffic duty... and who shares a mysterious past connection with Se Ra. To both Cheong Ja and Cheol's surprise, they begin to fall for each other, sending their lives onto an entirely new trajectory.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

He's been waiting for her so that they can get started making treats and decorating for Sadiebug's and Kadiebug's party that afternoon. But Custard and Pupcake have enjoyed their time outside so much that they want to continue playing.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

He can't wait to share his new crop (the perfect bitty size) with Berry Bitty City, so Strawberry volunteers to help him transport the produce to Orange's General Store.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry is really touched when her girlfriends and the Berrykins volunteer to help her with the construction of her new marketplace, so when the girls suggest they take charge of designing Strawberry's dream-bedroom to go on the second story, of course Strawberry agrees. While construction is going on, the girls each show Strawberry their individual ideas for the bedroom.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With time running out before the Grand Opening celebration for the new Marketplace, Strawberry's friends get the idea to invite her favorite singer, superstar CHERRY JAM, to be the guest singer. The girls are blown away when their berryjuice cell phone gets a text message that Cherry accepts their invitation! Strawberry is touched by their surprise, but reminds them that now the town and Marketplace really have to shine!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Cherry Jam is so enjoying staying in Berry Bitty City, that she calls her managers in Big Bitty City and informs them that she is going to stay for a much needed vacation! Strawberry and the girls are thrilled that she will be with them for a little longer, and they do all they can to make their guest comfortable. But Cherry doesn't want to be treated like a guest she wants to fit in and contribute to the community.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Berry Bitty City is holding its first city-wide talent show! Hearing that it's the music students of superstar Cherry Jam, a talent scout from Big Bitty City plans to show up. Strawberry and her friends excitedly anticipate her arrival.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Raspberry is discovered by a talent scout who wants her to move to Berry Big City and design a new line of Glitter fashions! She will be provided with her own studio, staff, publicity, commitments from big department stores-everything she needs to be a big fashion designing star! All her friends are thrilled for her. Only Cherry is a bit less enthusiastic about Raspberry's stardom, which Raspberry mistakenly interprets as jealousy.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With the summer almost over, Blueberry overhears Strawberry talking about a wonderful tropical island and believes her friend is going to surprise them all with a much needed vacation! Blueberry makes the other girls promise to keep the secret until Strawberry reveals the big surprise. Of course, even though they've promised to keep the secret, they can't help but try and suss out what the island's like from every little thing Strawberry does.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's the last week of summer and Berry Bitty City is hopping with activity as the girls prepare for their tropical island vacation at Berry Breezy Bay Resort. But just as they're about to leave, bad news: the resort is closed for the season due to berry breezy weather. The girls are disappointed, but Orange isn't giving up. She says if they can't go to the tropical island, maybe they can bring the tropical island here!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With only a few days of summer left, the girls are about to enjoy their first vacation in their newly-created, tropical beach resort at Berry Bitty Lake, when who should descend upon them but Mavis Maraschino, the comically over-the-top "Entertainment Tonight"-style show host. Mavis has dumped her focus on fashions in favor of an even glitzier show called Lifestyles of the Berry Big Bitty Stars, and she wants her first segment to be about how pop superstar Cherry Jam spends her vacation.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: On a beautiful winter's night, Blueberry reads the Baby Berrykins a story of what happened one winter in Berry Bitty City-a winter that almost wasn't. Just as everyone is ready for winter fun and fashions, a sudden warming melts the snow and ruins their plans. Improvising with snowmen made of shaved ice and cotton puffs, Strawberry and her friends play "Capture the Snowman's Carrot Nose." The Berrykins want to join in the fun, so the girls play against them, with Strawberry refereeing.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's another windy winter day, and the postal bees are staying indoors-the wind is too strong for their berry bitty wings. "We don't know when the next mail will get through!" It's bad news for Blueberry, who has been anxiously awaiting the next installment of a Patty Persimmon Detective story. If only she could get to the post office in Berry Bitty Dale where her package is waiting!

programme.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
programme.desc: Monty bases himself at Rousham House in Oxfordshire, designed by one of the first practitioners of the landscape movement, William Kent. It has survived almost unchanged since its completion in 1741.

programme.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
programme.desc: Monty Don explores the extraordinary transformations that occurred throughout the 19th century. As a result of an expanding empire, scientific and technological innovation and social change, British gardens became more widely accessible.

programme.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
programme.desc: Monty Don concludes his journey through Britain's gardening heritage by looking at how the nation's gardens have evolved over the last hundred years. He looks at the profound effect that two world wars had on the attitude to gardens and gardening.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Adam Frost continues to develop his new woodland border, ably assisted by Ash the cat. He also gets to work on his veg plot and has a few tips on how to get the best out of the native bluebell.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty expands the planting on the mound, gathers self-sown seedlings and prepares for a summer display in the cottage garden. Meanwhile, Nick Bailey travels to Devon to explore a stunning garden that combines historic charm with modern garden design.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Gardeners' World comes from the first big flower show of the season: the RHS Malvern Spring Festival. Arit Anderson and Joe Swift discover the newest varieties of plants and flowers that are hot off the potting bench.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty is busy moving his tender succulents outdoors and makes a start on planting up his new cut flower beds. Plus, in North Yorkshire, Frances Tophill visits the gardens at Newby Hall.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With summer feasts in mind, Monty reveals a new outdoor eating area he has been working on and gets started by planting up a delicious pot of herbs. Now that any threat of frost has past, he also plants out tender plants to give months of colour.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With summer around the corner, Monty reveals his plans for planting up pots in his cottage garden, shares tips on how to start your own topiary from scratch, and in the veg garden, gets some pumpkins in the ground.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: The team are Birmingham-bound for one of the highlights of the horticultural year, the annual "Gardeners' World Live" event, and there is design inspiration for even the smallest of spaces.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: In Southampton, sociable bachelor Morgan has £5,000 for a party garden, with a nod to his years at sea working on cruise ships. The space must also have privacy, a water feature and, as a proud Welshman, the feeling of his homeland.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: The Rich brothers are joined by Arit Anderson to help create an all-year-round garden in Byfleet for stylish octogenarian Gay, to enjoy the birds and remember her late husband. She wants a garden which is simple to manage, but also welcoming.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: The team are in Shoreham by Sea, helping John and David. They have £4,500 to turn their tired garden into the perfect place to host their wedding reception. With a relatively small house, the surprisingly spacious outside space must pull its weight.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Karen and Duncan in Shefford complain that their garden is too plain, and they don't like straight lines so they want curves instead. The Rich brothers and Arit Anderson try to create something modern but which also has rustic elements.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty plants for pollinators in the Wildlife Garden and trims his box topiary cones. He also takes succulent leaf cuttings and continues the summer veg harvest. Meanwhile, Carol Klein visits stunning Italian-influenced gardens in Gloucestershire.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don has advice on how to successfully store an apple crop so it will last through winter and explains why he thinks it high time wall flowers came back into fashion. With tomatoes now over, Monty clears his greenhouse.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Adam Frost shares the progress that's been made in his garden. Frances Tophill heads to the beach to reveal what gardeners can learn from the coastal plants which have evolved to cope with more extreme conditions.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: In Brighton determined duo Helen and Dax have their hands full with twins, one of whom has special needs. Meanwhile in High Wycombe, newly single Valerie is looking for a fresh lease of life.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: Monty Don visits two sets of ambitious gardeners, each facing challenges on a very different scale. One is a tiny urban courtyard in Hackney and the other is an outdoor area for a community.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: Monty meets two sets of gardeners who have unimaginable ambitions for their outdoor spaces. In Essex Denise has never ventured beyond the decking area behind her house. Meanwhile in Ipswich, a father and daughter plan to build a terraced allotment.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: Monty comes to the rescue of two couples in need of help transforming their rubble filled back gardens into havens of peace and tranquillity. They are in serious need of help and advice, but can Monty set them on the right track?

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: Two gardeners, each living on their own, are hoping Monty can help them. In Blackpool, Alex dreams of turning her boring backyard into a magical enchanted forest. Also in Bristol, Ross has taken on a very over-grown allotment.

programme.title: Kew on a Plate
programme.desc: It is spring at Kew and after a long, dark winter, nature is coming back to life. Raymond makes his sublime version of rhubarb and custard and Kate finds out how a 12-year-old slave enabled vanilla to become the world's most popular flavour.

programme.title: Kew on a Plate
programme.desc: Summer has arrived at Kew and everything in Raymond Blanc and Kate Humble's garden is blooming. Butterflies and bees abound and there are new crops to tend, harvest and cook with. Raymond must protect his crop of carrots.

programme.title: Kew on a Plate
programme.desc: It's autumn at Kew and the vegetable garden is set to produce a bumper harvest. Raymond Blanc and Kate Humble grow some autumnal favourites and cook them up. Kate finds out why the tomato was once considered to be a deadly poison.

programme.title: Kew on a Plate
programme.desc: The end of the year at Kew is fast approaching, winter is setting in, but some crops positively love the cold and Raymond learns how brassicas cope in this frosty season. Kate visits Kew's Millennium Seed Bank.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: The roses are in full bloom at Longmeadow as Monty tackles some emergency pruning needed on one of his favourite crab apples. Adam Frost travels to the Birmingham Botanical Gardens to discover more about the huge restoration project taking place.
